integrity: Proof derives the field-uniform formulas; finite reproducibility checks independently test selected fields, rather than certifying all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Endomorphisms of a three-variable cubic box algebra only; no all-dimensional, all-exponent, scheme-theoretic or independent-certification claim. Earlier unindexed equivalent fiber counts remain a priority risk.
title: Arithmetic cube-zero strata and the full cotangent-rank census of a cubic box algebra
